author: BBC Earth
description:
Only one third of plants in US gardens are native. To help change that, Nurture Nature co-founder Esther Bonney explains how restoring native biodiversity supports local wildlife and strengthens ecosystems. 

#FixingThePlanet is a digital series, sponsored by @speedandscale, that spotlights the everyday choices and cutting-edge innovations that can help us preserve our planet for generations to come.
